verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that 1Password can store one-time passwords and can export data to move it to a different app. It never documents a recovery path or cross-device sync that restores stored tokens on a new device after a phone is lost. Export for migrating to another app and Apple Watch lookup are adjacent features, not the documented restore path this story asks for.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device
